title: Builder BLD-106: Command bar

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-106.

detail: B1 Shell, pass BLD-106 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-106). Command bar. Scope: components/builder/command. Build: ⌘K and Ctrl+K, plus a visible button on touch. Three groups: Go to (sections, pages), Do (every action in the action registry), Ask Vera. Each row shows its shortcut; recent commands first. Done when: Every toolbar and rail action is reachable from ⌘K; Focus trapped while open, returned on close. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-101. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-106.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
